Hi Nina,

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching: Redwood's DPIA support template and a summarized processor-records export.

A few points to note up front:
- DPA / Art.28-30: Our standard DPA covers processor obligations, subprocessors, and the data processing addendum. The full DPA is available for signature; we can send via DocuSign or a secure link.
- Subprocessors: Monica will attach a CSV export with current subprocessors and processing region tags. That file includes the vendor name, processing purpose, location(s), and whether the vendor processes data outside the EEA.
- Transfers: Redwood uses EU SCCs for customer data transfers as a default where data leaves the EEA. For enterprise customers with specific requirements we can evaluate BCRs or contractual addenda.
- Audit rights: We offer contractual audit rights limited to scoped reviews on the infrastructure and operational controls. For most customers we provide: SOC 2 Type II reports, pen test summaries, redacted logs on request, and an onsite/virtual audit option in enterprise engagements (subject to NDAs and scheduling).

Questions for you:
- Will EuroCorp require us to host solely in an EU region (no cross-border processing)? If so, we can present a regional deployment plan.
- Any particular retention requirements or DPIA risk scenarios (profiling, special category data)?

I attached: DPIA_Template_Redwood.pdf and a light summary CSV (GDPR_Processor-Records-Export.csv). Monica will follow with the full export and a short transfer-mechanism note.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
